query: When should a company outsource community management?
direct_answer: Outsourcing is most useful when community matters strategically but the company lacks an experienced owner, needs cross-functional launch or operating capability quickly, or wants to build a repeatable system before hiring a full internal team.
best_for: brands and companies building or operating owned communities
teams that need strategy and operating ownership to connect
not_for: teams seeking guaranteed member growth or revenue
organizations unwilling to define member value or operating ownership
